{{Quote|A stellar work, one part computer, one part holocron. Truly ingenious.|Vandar Tokare|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], a special '''terminal''' located within the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] was capable of combining the power of the three [[Noetikon]]s. The terminal on Coruscant was destroyed by the [[Unidentified Sith apprentice (Lord Vivicar)|Sith apprentice]] of [[Parkanas Tark|Lord Vivicar]], but it was later reconstructed on [[Tython/Legends|Tython]].
